title: The Echo That Maps a Cave
short_teaser: Sound returning from surfaces can reveal distance, shape, and hidden space.
story: Sound returning from surfaces can reveal distance, shape, and hidden space. Information can travel back to us through reflection. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Information can travel back to us through reflection. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen.
spark_application: Spend five quiet minutes noticing something that creates awe or surprise. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
